description: Use this when the user asks about one company or ticker in general: 'tell me about X', 'what does X do', 'how is X doing', 'explain X stock', its price, chart or business. Shows invest-like's stock page in a card: price and one-year chart, one plain sentence, four checks with the numbers behind them (is it profitable, growing, fairly priced, carrying debt), strengths, risks, what to watch, the halal result, how many of seven investors' published rulebooks it meets, and invest-like's stored AI analysis when one exists. Covers 21,000+ stocks in 60+ countries, refreshed daily. For 'is X a good buy' or 'is X undervalued' use check_value instead.

stock.description: Ticker or company name, e.g. 'NVDA', 'Coca-Cola' or 'SAP.DE'

name: explain_stock
title: Explain a stock in plain English
